title: case.opened payload (v1)
description: Case opened (OPEN). Emitted by cases via the transactional outbox with the case state change. Producer: cases. Exchange: aegispulse.domain. FRs: FR-CASE-01, FR-CASE-03. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
